annotations.title: Check carrier broker dealer registration lifecycle

description: FREE CARRIER/BROKER/DEALER REGISTRATION LIFECYCLE tool for England. Select when the unresolved question is a new registration, renewal, detail/activity change, legal-type change, or lower-to-upper change for a carrier, broker or dealer. Supply role and lifecycle action, plus own-waste/tier facts when relevant. Returns a bounded route, fee route, findings and official evidence. It is read-only and never submits or renews a registration. Do NOT use for site permit changes or DWT reporting readiness.

action.description: Registration lifecycle action. Use renew only for an existing registration; use change_* only for an existing registration change.
action.title: Action

construction_demolition_waste.description: For an own-waste carrier, whether construction or demolition waste is carried; this affects the current route.
construction_demolition_waste.title: Construction Demolition Waste

existing_registration_tier.description: Existing registration tier for renewal checks. Do not infer the tier from the user's business type.
existing_registration_tier.title: Existing Registration Tier

nation.description: UK nation. This workflow currently supports England only.
nation.title: Nation

own_waste_only.description: For carriers, whether the business transports only waste it produces itself. Leave null if not established.
own_waste_only.title: Own Waste Only

role.description: Registration role being checked: carrier, broker, or dealer.
role.title: Role
